ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Campus Social uses the camera to scan QR tickets, member cards and order pickups when you help run a society. Nothing is recorded or saved.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose a photo for your profile, society logo, event cover or banner, or a screenshot of your payment for the society treasurer.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Campus Social adds the events you sign up for to your calendar. It never reads your other events.
ios.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: Campus Social adds the events you sign up for to your calendar. It never reads your other events.
